hook: Cheap HFIP solvent can serve as a source of CF3 groups for modifying drug-like molecules.
summary: CF3 groups tune how drug candidates behave, and this method pulls them from HFIP, a common cheap solvent, using light, electricity, and an iron catalyst. It adds CF3 to arenes, heteroarenes, and alkenes, and selectively to tryptophan in peptides. Yields and scope are reported for lab-scale reactions only.
title: Empowering HFIP as a Radical Trifluoromethylating Reagent by Photoelectrochemical Iron Catalysis
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
